newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MONACO WIN 2-0, MOVE WITHIN A POINT OF PSG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO WIN 2-0, MOVE WITHIN A POINT OF PSG.

text.p: Nigeria's Victor Ikpeba and Scot John Collins scored the goals as Monaco beat Nancy 2-0 at home to move just one point behind leaders Paris Saint-Germain in the French first division on Saturday.
PSG, held 0-0 at home by Marseille on Friday, have 39 points to Monaco's 38 after 19 matches.

Bastia climbed to third on 33 points with a suprise 2-1 win at champions Auxerre. Yugoslav striker Anton Drobnjak scored both Bastia's goals, the first a 28th-minute penalty equaliser, to take his tally for the season to 10.
Auxerre, brilliant winners away to Ajax Amsterdam in the European Champions' League on Wednesday, have now gone four domestic matches without a victory.
Bordeaux, 5-3 conquerors of PSG last weekend, could only manage a 2-2 draw at Lyon and dropped to joint fourth with Metz and Strasbourg on 31 points.
